methods_quotes.q: Data were statistically adjusted by using multiple imputation techniques to account for missing HIV transmission categories
Receipt of any HIV care, defined as having one or more CD4 or viral load tests during 2014,
retention in care, defined as having two or more CD4 or viral load tests ≥3 months apart
viral suppression, defined as a viral load of <200 HIV RNA copies/mL at most recent test
Reported numbers smaller than 12 and their accompanying percentages also should be interpreted with caution.
